Thessaly pauses with the sweet halfway to her mouth.

“That’s correct,” she says. “Paraphrase is how a sentence becomes someone else’s problem.”

Ashara laughs into her soup. “At least the library taught you something useful.”

Caelindra studies you with a new, narrower interest. “Copying Fae texts without altering them is more demanding than most people expect.”

Rashid tears off a piece of bread. “And a better preparation for Conclave records than it sounds.”

Seraphel’s wings shift softly behind her chair.

“Words kept precise  
can outlive those who write them.”

Thessaly sets down her sweet. “Which Fae library?”
